name: Cerebras
description: Cerebras provides ultra-fast AI inference and training through its wafer-scale chip architecture and cloud platform, supporting leading open-source models.
bestFor: Developers needing high-speed AI inference
Enterprises requiring low-latency model deployment
AI researchers training large language models
strengths: World's fastest AI inference, up to 15x faster than GPU-based systems
Wafer-scale architecture unifies compute, memory, and bandwidth on a single chip
OpenAI-compatible API with Python and TypeScript SDKs
Supports models from leading open-source families including Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek
gettingStarted: Sign up at cloud.cerebras.ai
Generate an API key from the Cerebras platform
Make your first API call using the OpenAI-compatible endpoint
usageNotes: Cerebras Inference offers a free trial with $5 in credits after account creation
Developer tier pay-per-token pricing starts at $0.35 per million input tokens and $0.75 per million output tokens for GPT OSS 120B
Playground allows testing models and prompts directly in the browser without code
Supports tool/function calling, structured outputs, and streaming responses
Available through partner clouds including AWS Marketplace and Hugging Face
priceDetails: Free tier with $5 credits; Developer tier pay-per-token from $0.35/M input tokens; Pro $50/month; Enterprise custom pricing

name: Windsurf
description: An agentic AI-powered IDE developed by Codeium, featuring the Cascade AI assistant for deep codebase context awareness, multi-file editing, and task execution .
bestFor: Developers seeking an AI-first IDE experience with an integrated agentic assistant
Teams wanting a collaborative AI coding environment with centralized billing
Users who prefer a visual editor over a terminal-based workflow
Developers working on context-heavy tasks requiring persistent awareness across sessions
strengths: Cascade agentic system providing real-time awareness and 'Flows' for persistent context
Automatic rule discovery and memory system for customizing AI behavior
Largest free tier among comparable AI coding tools
Integration of Devin's capabilities, such as DeepWiki for codebase understanding
gettingStarted: Navigate to the official Windsurf website and download the installer for your platform (e.g., Windows, macOS)
Install and launch the Windsurf IDE
Open a project or create a new one
Press Cmd/Ctrl+L or click the Cascade icon to open the AI assistant panel
usageNotes: Cascade offers three primary modes: 'Code' for autonomous changes, 'Plan' for multi-step planning, and 'Ask' for read-only analysis
Pricing is subscription-based with a quota system that replaced monthly credits. Free, Pro ($20/month), Teams ($40/seat/month), and Max ($200/month) plans are available
Quotas refresh daily/weekly, and unlimited Tab autocomplete does not consume quota
The tool is a proprietary standalone IDE, not a VS Code fork, so it has a smaller extension ecosystem
Features like Memories and Rules allow for persistent customization and context

name: Google Antigravity
description: Google's agent-first software development platform that evolved from an AI-powered IDE to an orchestration suite for managing autonomous AI agents, including a desktop app, CLI, and SDK .
bestFor: Building and managing AI agents for software development
Developers wanting to orchestrate multi-agent workflows
Developers seeking an agentic coding tool integrated with Google's ecosystem
strengths: Multi-agent parallel orchestration with artifact-based verification
Support for multiple models including Gemini and Claude from the free tier
Deep integration with Google ecosystem (AI Studio, Firebase, Android)
gettingStarted: Download the Google Antigravity desktop application from the official website
Sign in with a Google account
Open an existing project or start a new one in the chat interface
usageNotes: Antigravity CLI (agy) replaces the legacy Gemini CLI
The platform has a free tier with generous limits, but heavier use may require a paid Google AI subscription
The desktop app is a standalone application with a chat-first interface, distinct from the Antigravity IDE
priceDetails: Free tier available; Google AI Pro at $19.99/mo and Google AI Ultra at $100/mo offer increased limits

name: Antigravity CLI
description: A terminal-based interface (TUI) for the Antigravity 2.0 agentic coding assistant, designed to help build, modify, test, and release Flutter applications, replacing the legacy Gemini CLI .
bestFor: Flutter and Dart developers seeking a terminal-based AI coding assistant for building and releasing applications
Users migrating from the legacy Gemini CLI
strengths: Terminal-based user interface (TUI) for a coding assistant
Supports automatic migration of settings from the legacy Gemini CLI
Respects workspace rules files like AGENTS.md for custom coding guidelines
gettingStarted: Install using one of the following commands: curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/install.sh | bash (macOS/Linux), irm https://antigravity.google/install.ps1 | iex (Windows PowerShell), or winget install Google.AntigravityCLI (Windows Command Prompt)
Verify installation by running: agy --version
The first run will automatically check for and migrate settings from an existing Gemini CLI configuration
usageNotes: Replaces the legacy Gemini CLI for Dart and Flutter development
Supports local rules from .agents/skills/ or AGENTS.md, and maintains backward compatibility with GEMINI.md
Global settings and MCP server configurations are stored in ~/.antigravity/ (e.g., ~/.antigravity/mcp_config.json)

name: Grok Build
description: A terminal-native AI coding agent from xAI that can plan, develop, and deploy applications from natural language prompts. It supports interactive TUI, headless scripting, and embedding via the Agent Client Protocol (ACP).
bestFor: Professional software engineers
Complex codebase tasks
End-to-end edit-run-test loops
Automated scripts and CI/CD pipelines
strengths: Supports custom model endpoints compatible with OpenAI API
Can operate in an interactive TUI, headlessly, or via ACP
Open-sourced CLI harness for developer inspection
Can coordinate workflows with up to 1,024 parallel agents
Compatible with Claude Code's configuration files (.claude/) for easier migration
gettingStarted: Install via curl on macOS/Linux: `curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash`
Install via PowerShell on Windows: `irm https://x.ai/cli/install.ps1 | iex`
Authenticate by opening a browser on first launch, or set `XAI_API_KEY` environment variable
Start a session with `grok` in a project directory
usageNotes: Grok Build is available to SuperGrok and X Premium subscribers
Plan Mode maps out changes step-by-step for review before any code is written
User data retention for training is opt-in and off by default
Version 1.0 introduced expanded command-approval prompts for enhanced security
Created apps can be published with a unique `grok.me` domain
priceDetails: Available on SuperGrok and X Premium plans

name: GitHub Copilot
description: An AI-powered coding assistant developed by GitHub that provides code completions and chat-based support to help developers write code faster and more efficiently .
bestFor: Code completion and autocomplete suggestions
Code explanation and debugging via chat
Generating unit tests and boilerplate code
Pull request assistance and code reviews
strengths: Integrates with popular IDEs such as Visual Studio Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio, and more
Offers multi-model support, including access to models from Anthropic and OpenAI
Supports agentic workflows for autonomous code editing and task completion
gettingStarted: Install the GitHub Copilot extension for your preferred IDE (e.g., Visual Studio Code, JetBrains, Vim/Neovim, Eclipse, Xcode)
Sign up for an individual plan or request access through an organization
Start using Copilot by typing code in your IDE to see autocomplete suggestions, or open the Copilot Chat interface
usageNotes: Features and availability depend on the subscription plan (Free, Pro, Pro+, Business, Enterprise)
Copilot Free offers limited access; some features like GitHub Skills and PR summaries are not included
Paid plans provide expanded model access, agentic workflows, and enterprise-grade features
priceDetails: Free plan available; paid plans start at approximately $10/month
